description: List files and folders in a specific folder with field selection.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Omit for all fields. Available: id, name, mimeType, webViewLink, modifiedTime, parents, shared, starred, owners

folderId.description: Folder ID to list contents (use "root" for Drive root)

pageSize.description: Number of items per page (default: 50, max: 1000). Accepts numbers or numeric strings.

pageToken.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results (drive format). Omit for first page.

shape.description: Response shape: objects (keyed) or arrays (columnar, matching fields order)

name: folder-contents

count.description: Number of items in this page

folderId.description: ID of the folder that was listed

items.description: Files and folders in the specified folder

createdTime.description: ISO datetime when file was created

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., application/pdf, image/png)

modifiedTime.description: ISO datetime when file was last modified

me.description: Whether this owner is the current user

parents.description: Parent folders with ID and name

permissions.description: Current user's permissions on this file

shared.description: Whether the file is shared with others

size.description: File size in bytes as string

starred.description: Whether the file is starred by the user

trashed.description: Whether the file is in trash

webContentLink.description: Direct download link for the file

webViewLink.description: URL to view the file in Google Drive

nextPageToken.description: Token for fetching next page of results

count.description: Number of items in this page

folderId.description: ID of the folder that was listed

nextPageToken.description: Token for fetching next page of results

title: List Folder Contents
